objects.name: Attack Flow
objects.description: Extends STIX 2.1 with features to create Attack Flows.

objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-obfuscated-files-or-information-via-rar-sfx
objects.description: The following analytic detects the creation of RAR Self-Extracting (SFX) files by monitoring the generation of file related to rar sfx .tmp file creation during sfx installation. This method leverages a heuristic to identify RAR SFX archives based on specific markers that indicate a combination of executable code and compressed RAR data. By tracking such activity, the analytic helps pinpoint potentially unauthorized or suspicious file creation events, which are often associated with malware pack
